primary_relations: Only supported components with no pending/unsupported overlap
scene: Human-reviewed adopted scene label, NOT an AI visible trait
different_room: Different confirmed components; different buildings exclude unknown same-room leakage
same_building: Explicit baseline only, not declared scene similarity
matching: Report native AND donor horizon difference<=2
same_room_prediction: Uses only other views in target supported component
shared_worker: Same actual IDs in both views, no geometric coordinate registration claimed
comparison_unit: Images then building, not donor pairs as independent physical rooms
